plain: The story is that in 1964 there were footprints on the ground at Socorro, New Mexico, where an object was reported, and that seeing them is what changed the mind of an astronomer named J. Allen Hynek about UFOs. John Blitch, a scientist who worked with the Pentagon's research agency DARPA and who says he was himself abducted, tells Michels this briefly, without naming a source: Hynek "saw them and that's what flipped him".
